briefdescription.para: Engine-side commutative monomial monoid: variable names, ordering, multidegree machinery, and monomial encoding/decoding.

detaileddescription.para: Owns the front-end MonomialOrdering* mo_ plus its compiled MonomialOrder* monorder_ form, the variable count and names, the per-variable multidegrees, the heft vector, and (recursively) a mDegreeMonoid describing how degrees themselves are structured. Exposes the operations rings reduce against (mult, divide, lcm, gcd, compare, is_one, plus encode / decode between exponent vectors and packed monomial words). The commutative counterpart of FreeMonoid in the NC stack.
